name: wytpass-sdk-monorepo
description: Monorepo for WytPass SSO / OAuth2 / OpenID Connect SDKs for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@wytpass/core && npm run build --workspace=@wytpass/react && npm run build --workspace=@wytpass/nextjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@wytpass/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@wytpass/react && npm run typecheck --workspace=@wytpass/nextjs

author: Wytnet <support@wytnet.com>
